basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old avid hockey fan from Toronto, Canada. My passion for the sport led me to the NHLHUT subreddit, where I often share my experiences and frustrations with EA Sports' NHL series. I'm a graphic designer by day and an amateur hockey player by night. I'm single and spend most of my evenings online, catching up on the latest NHL news and engaging with fellow fans. My interests include sports analytics, gaming, and binge-watching crime documentaries.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, which I studied at a local college. My knowledge of hockey comes from years of playing the sport and closely following the NHL. I also have a keen interest in gaming, particularly sports simulation games, which I have been playing since my teenage years.
